items.student_text: Solve $x^2+18x=34$ by completing the square. $x=9\pm\sqrt{115}$ $x=-9\pm115$ $x=-9\pm\sqrt{115}$. $x=25$
items.solution_html: Add 81 to both sides: $(x+9)^2=115$. Take square roots: $x+9=\pm\sqrt{115}$, so $x=-9\pm\sqrt{115}$.
